text: From which a judgment might be formed of the advantages which resolution carries with it, inasmuch as those whom for some time they had groundlessly dreaded when unarmed, they had afterwards vanquished, when well armed and flushed with success.
author: Julius Caesar
speaker: Caesar
reference: Commentaries on the Gallic and Civil Wars
translation: W. A. McDevitte and W. S. Bohn, 1869
